evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'take about ten minutes' but does not frame a time-boxed ask with promise of dependable quote, nor wait for a yes before continuing. Rushes straight into the process.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Mike), moving day (Sunday), from address (1922 Night Star Lane), to address (1507 Ashford Hollow Lane), size (1800 sq ft, one story, three bedrooms) — all four collected.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asks 'What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?' before probing logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises gym equipment, total gym, trees in pots. Rep follows up: 'if I may ask for the gym equipment. So what are those gym equipment that?' then 'do you have like anything that weighs more than 500 pounds?' then 'what's the rest of the gym equipment?' and 'So I bet that it doesn't weigh like more than 500 pounds, right?' — multiple follow-up questions on each concern.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection offered. Rep acknowledges concerns but does not reflect back what was heard as a confirmed bundle.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Collected: property type (house), floor/stories (one story), bedrooms (three), square footage (1800), parking distance (30 feet per rep's summary), addresses (from and to). Did not explicitly probe: number of rooms beyond bedroom count, additional rooms, special considerations beyond those volunteered, or additional stops. Partial coverage.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not offered. Customer volunteered they can handle boxes themselves; rep did not offer packing service.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_routing: Rep identifies 1800 sq ft home as 'considered a large move' and routes to 'a large move specialist' with callback promise within the day. Routing is clean and confirmed before disconnect.

top_strength: Rep successfully identified the 1800 sq ft threshold, correctly routed to a large-move specialist, and confirmed the callback handoff without abandoning the call mid-pitch.
coaching_note: Section 1 lacks the time-boxed, dependable-quote framing and wait-for-yes checkpoint; Section 2 never summarizes the customer's concerns back as a confirmation before moving forward; packing services and box-count questions (Section 3) were never offered despite being standard even on routed calls.
